US Secretary of State Marco Rubio to Visit India for Energy and Tech Talks

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is scheduled to visit Mumbai and Jamnagar in India from October 17-22. The visit aims to boost energy cooperation and revive technology ties between the US and India. The trip occurs amid ongoing trade talks between the two nations, with discussions also touching upon tensions related to Russian oil and US tariffs. A US National Security Council delegation is also expected to arrive ahead of Rubio's visit to further discussions on technology ties.
